page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance engineered for machine learning inference, graphics workloads, and parallel processing tasks. Running on the KVM hypervisor, the instance is powered by a dedicated 2.9 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor featuring an x86_64 architecture with 4 physical cores and 8 virtual CPUs via hyperthreading. The CPU subsystem is supported by 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, 48 MB of L3 cache, and instruction set support including AVX-512 with VNNI, AES-NI, and SHA-NI cryptography extensions.

Hardware acceleration is driven by a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU equipped with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. System memory measures 30.0 GB of RAM, yielding an allocation of 3.75 GB per virtual core. Network throughput provides a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, while local disk storage is not bundled, requiring persistent data to be attached via external network block storage.

Performance benchmarks reflect mid-tier CPU capabilities paired with high-throughput accelerator metrics. While general-purpose tests such as Geekbench (1,580 single-core, 5,901 multi-core) and PassMark CPU (11,364.98) place the processor in the middle 50% tier, the A10 accelerator achieves top-tier results in AI evaluation. The instance processes 9,665.83 prompt tokens per second and 456.78 generation tokens per second on 135M parameter models, alongside 2,504.89 prompt tokens per second and 90.71 generation tokens per second on 7B parameter architectures.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the instance provides cost-effective density by pairing mid-range CPU capacity with a versatile 24 GB enterprise GPU. The lack of onboard NVMe storage necessitates external volume management, making ecs.gn7i-c8g1.2xlarge best suited for real-time model inference, lightweight model fine-tuning, computer vision processing, and accelerated cloud graphics rendering.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance designed for AI inference and graphic processing workloads. Built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture, the instance incorporates an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz with 4 physical cores and 8 dedicated vCPUs, alongside 30 GB of system RAM. Hardware acceleration is provided by a bundled NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. Networking features a 16 Gbps baseline, with no local disk storage included. While host processor scores land in the average tier on Geekbench and PassMark, GPU performance reaches the top decile in LLM inference benchmarks, achieving 2,504.89 prompt tokens per second on 7B models. This hardware profile makes the instance an efficient platform for deep learning inference, image processing, cloud rendering, and media transcoding pipelines.
